第81章 一等鬼差权限-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

说完，又嫌老刘腿脚不利索，自顾自冲到柜台后面，自己挑货去了。

直到把车子的后座和后备箱都塞得满满当当，这才算完。

老刘看到他装了这么多东西，忍不住问道：“你小子这是得罪谁了，一下子要烧这么多？”

吴姜正在付账，闻言斜着眼睛瞥了他一眼：“我说我得罪黑白无常了，你信吗？”

老刘嗤之以鼻，半点不信他的屁话。

“得罪黑白无常好啊，到时候刘叔多给你烧些纸钱下去，保证你小子有钱花！”

吴姜听着老刘的调侃，只是呵呵一笑，也不辩驳，这年头，就是说实话没人信。

付钱走人，干净利索，完全没理会老刘在身后扯着嗓子大喊：“你小子下次再敢半夜砸门，看我不打断你的狗腿！”

吴姜将车开到了之前和老道斗法的地方，这里人烟稀少，到了深夜，更是连半个鬼影都没有，非常适合他焚烧祭品。

将车上的东西一股脑的卸下来，在空地上铺了一大片，打火机点燃，一边烧一边小声念叨：“两位老大，你们可不能跟属下一般见识啊，要怪您就去怪判官大人，属下可是无辜的，今天这些东西都是专门供奉给你们的，没有其他人的份，你们慢慢享用。”

火光越烧越旺，映得整片空地一片通红，纸钱燃烧的灰烬被风吹起，打着旋儿飘向半空。

吴姜又跑回车子，将上次留下的那条华子拿了下来，拆开之后，一股脑扔进了火里。

“两位老大，今天给你们换换口味，这可是华子，要是你们喜欢抽，下次属下再给你们多烧几条！”

一个多小时后，直到火堆熄灭，吴姜才拍了拍手，站起身，搞定收工。

回到家，重新躺回床上，这才有功夫琢磨起一等鬼差究竟多了哪些权限。

他集中精神，将意识沉入阴差令牌，仔细查看起来，这一看，顿时眼前一亮。

一等鬼差的权限，比他想象中还要丰厚。

After saying that, he felt that Lao Liu's legs were not in good condition, so he rushed behind the counter and picked out the goods by himself.

It's not done until the back seat and trunk of the car are filled to the brim.

When Lao Liu saw that he had packed so many things, he couldn't help but ask: "Who did you offend? You want to burn so many things at once?"

Wu Jiang was paying the bill. Hearing this, he glanced sideways at him: "I said I offended Black and White Wuchang, do you believe it?"

Lao Liu scoffed, not believing his bullshit at all.

"It's good to offend Black and White. When the time comes, Uncle Liu will burn some more paper money for you, and I'll make sure you have money to spend!"

When Wu Jiang listened to Old Liu's teasing, he just laughed and didn't argue. These days, no one would believe him even if he told the truth.

Pay the money and leave neatly, completely ignoring Lao Liu shouting at the top of his voice behind him: "Next time you dare to break down the door in the middle of the night, see if I don't break your legs!"

Wu Jiang drove the car to the place where he had fought with the old Taoist before. The place was sparsely populated, and late at night, there were not even half a ghost, which was very suitable for him to burn sacrifices.

He unloaded all the things from the car and spread them out over a large area in the open space. He lit them with a lighter and whispered while burning: "Boss, you can't be as knowledgeable as your subordinates. If you want to blame you, blame the judge. I am innocent. These things are dedicated to you today. No one else has a share. You can enjoy them slowly."

The fire burned brighter and brighter, making the entire open space glow red. The ashes of the burning paper money were blown up by the wind and swirled into the air.

Wu Jiang ran back to the car, took off the piece of Hua Zi left last time, took it apart, and threw it into the fire.

"Two bosses, let me give you a change of flavor today. This is Huazi. If you like smoking, my subordinates will cook a few more for you next time!"

More than an hour later, when the fire was extinguished, Wu Jiang clapped his hands, stood up, and called it a day.

After returning home and lying on the bed again, I had time to think about what additional permissions the first-class ghost officer had.

He concentrated, sinking his consciousness into the Yin Cha Token, and examined it carefully. When he saw it, his eyes suddenly lit up.

The authority of a first-class ghost officer is more generous than he imagined.
